arts.ttl: Rani Khedira strike for Union Berlin hands St. Pauli record eighth straight Bundesliga defeat
arts.sum: Union Berlin edged past St. Pauli 1-0 at the Millerntor-Stadion thanks to Rani Khedira's 44th-minute strike. The decisive moment came in the 44th minute when Khedira reacted quickest to a half-cleared throw-in to fire low past Nikola Vasilj.

arts.ttl: Union Berlin climb into top half with combative win at St. Pauli
arts.sum: St. Pauli’s losing streak extended to a club-record eight league games, with their latest defeat coming at home against Union Berlin.

arts.ttl: St. Pauli vs. Union Berlin preview: Can the hosts end their losing run?
arts.sum: St. Pauli will look to end a seven-game losing run in the Bundesliga when they welcome Union Berlin to Millerntor-Stadion on Sunday.
